Notes for the owner (not table rows):

1. 21.167 repeats the whole-line formula Ἀντίνοος δ’ ἐνένιπεν ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’ ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε· of 21.84, and the validator forces the same `l`/`i` ("rebuked them"). Here the one rebuked is Leiodes alone (Greek states no object). The unit’s note says so. If the owner wants "him" here, 21.84 (odyssey-102) and the table row at 21.84 must change together.
2. 21.204 repeats the second line of 1.82 and of 20.239 (νοστῆσαι Ὀδυσῆα πολύφρονα ὅνδε δόμονδε); the shipped wording "to his own house" / "to his own home" is kept. The later table row ὅνδε δόμονδε (20.329) says "to this house" and turns down "to his own house", and it describes ὅνδε as the accusative of ὅδε; the glossary entry for ὅνδε (possessive ὅς + -δε, "to his own house") and the shipped uses (1.82, 20.239) agree with the repeat wording, so the 20.329 row is the odd one out. Left as shipped; the owner may want to revisit that row. (Reviewer: the unit’s note was wrong in calling ὅνδε the accusative of ὅδε and has been corrected.)
